description: test_step6_act.py::TestSanitizeName declares the parametrized case ('スキャン-coconala', '-coconala') with expected starting with '-', then bypasses strict equality (lines 36-41) and only asserts non-empty + safe-char invariant. This is tautological for the documented FIND-005 fix (REQ-T3 (iv) — empty-after-strip → 'unnamed'): the actual sanitize_name output is 'coconala' (= ascii suffix survives, Japanese prefix replaced with '-' then collapsed/stripped), NOT '-coconala'. The expectation column is misleading and the assertion is weaker than the spec table claims. A regression that produced (say) '___' or other purely-safe-char garbage would pass this test even though it violates the REQ-T3 intent.
